description:
Validate and persist the NEXT VERSION of a protocol document
(confirm-gated: each call appends a version row; accidental calls
clutter the version history). Edits create a new version — the
assignment pins the version it runs.

project_id.description:
Optional — bind the version to a project (the project
protocol page lists bound ids). Omitted, the id inherits its
latest version's binding server-side.

spec.description: Wire-format protocol document (validate first to iterate).

name: protocol.save
title: Save Protocol
